name: progress-07
description: Multi-step wizard header where Back and Next update a step progress bar.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Progress, ProgressLabel } from "@workspace/ui/components/progress" const steps = ["Account", "Profile", "Preferences", "Review"] export default function StepWizardProgress() { const [step, setStep] = React.useState(1) return (
{steps[step]} Step {step + 1} of {steps.length}

Fill in the {steps[step]?.toLowerCase()} details to continue.

) }
